name: skeletor
displayName: Skeletor — SaaS Launch Checklist & Reference Architecture
description: Opinionated, deterministic reference architecture for building a SaaS from idea to automated business. Ships a phased master checklist plus deep-dive design decisions for every system a SaaS needs. Use when planning, scoping, or building a SaaS product, generating a build roadmap, or filling gaps in a product plan.
